entries.jp: それは　龍馬達五人が\n大江戸天歌祭に向けて\n練習に励んでいた頃
entries.en:
This happened
back when Ryoma
and his four
bandmates were
practicing hard
for the Great Edo
Heaven's Song
Festival.

entries.jp:
お登勢は
龍馬達に呼び出され
彼らに指定された
場所へと向かっていた
entries.en:
Summoned by
Ryoma and the
others, Otose was
on her way to the
place they had
named.

entries.jp: んもう　龍ちゃんってば\n話したい事があるから\n今すぐ来てくれって
entries.en:
Honestly,
Ryo-chan! "I've
got somethin' to
tell ya, so come
right now," he
says...

entries.jp: 急にどういう\nつもりなのかしら\n全く見当もつかないわ
entries.en:
What's gotten into
him all of a
sudden? I haven't
the faintest idea.

entries.jp: とにかく　\n悪い話じゃないと\nいいけど……
entries.en: Anyway... I just\nhope it's not bad\nnews...

entries.jp:
お登勢は
不安そうに呟きつつ
古びた扉の前で
足を止めた
entries.en:
Muttering
anxiously, Otose
came to a stop
before an old,
weathered door.

entries.jp: えーと　\n指定された場所は\nここよね？
entries.en: Let's see... this is\nthe place they\ntold me, right?

entries.jp: 何が何だかわからないけど\n入ってみましょう
entries.en: I have no idea\nwhat's going on,\nbut let's go in.

entries.jp: ごめんくださーい
entries.en: Hellooo? Anyone\nhere?

entries.jp: はぁい　\nいらっしゃいませぇー♪
entries.en: Yeees~ Welcome\niiin~

entries.jp: …………ん？　\n何かしら\n今の妙な声色は
entries.en:
......Hm? What on
earth was that
funny voice just
now?

entries.jp: 誰かの声に似ている気も\nするけど……
entries.en: It sounded a bit\nlike someone I\nknow, but...

entries.jp: と言うか　ここの内装って\nうちの店に瓜二つじゃない\nどーいう事よ？
entries.en:
And come to think
of it, the inside of
this place is the
spitting image of
my inn! What's
going on here?

entries.jp: お登勢は\n周囲を見渡して\n怪訝そうに首を傾げる
entries.en:
Otose looked
around and tilted
her head,
puzzled.

entries.jp: その時　室内の奥から\n見覚えのある男達が現れ
entries.en:
Just then, some
familiar men
appeared from
the back of the
room

entries.jp: 体をくねらせながら\n駆け寄って来た
entries.en:
and came
scampering over,
wiggling their
hips.

entries.jp: わ～っ　お登勢やん\n早速来てくれたんだ\n嬉しい～～っ♪
entries.en:
Waaah,
Otose-yan! You
came already! I'm
sooo happy~!

entries.jp: あらまあ\n誰かと思ったら\nお登勢さんですか
entries.en:
Oh my, and who
might this be?
Why, it's
Otose-san.

entries.jp: よくいらっしゃいましたわ
entries.en: How lovely of you\nto come, dear.

entries.jp: ……んん？
ほら　貴女方も\nお客様に改めて\nご挨拶をしてくださいな
entries.en:
Come now, ladies,
greet our guest
properly, won't
you?

entries.jp: はぁ～～い
entries.en: Okaaay~

entries.jp: 可愛い可愛い女将さん　\nボク達のお店にようこそぉ
entries.en:
Our cute, cute
landlady~
Welcome to our
little shop~

entries.jp: ふん　よく来たわね\n私を待たせるなんて\nいい度胸だわっ
entries.en:
Hmph. So you
came. Keeping ME
waiting? You've
got some nerve,
honey!

entries.jp: ……い　いらっしゃいまし\nお待ちしておりました
entries.en: ...W-welcome...\nWe've been\nexpecting you...

entries.jp: ……んんんんんん？
entries.en: ......Hmmmmmmm?

entries.jp: ちょっとアンタ達\n何のつもりなのっ？
entries.en: Hold on, you boys!\nWhat is all this\nsupposed to be!?

entries.jp: ワケがわからないわ\nどこからどうツッコんだら\nいいのっ？
entries.en: I don't get it!\nWhere do I even\nstart!?

entries.jp: アタシにわかるように\n状況を説明して頂戴！
entries.en: Explain what's\ngoing on so I can\nunderstand it!

entries.jp: え～～　だから　今\n言ったじゃないですか
entries.en: Ehhh~ But we just\ntold you~

entries.jp: ボク達　雷舞活動の傍ら\n五人でお店を開く事に\nしたんですよぉ～
entries.en:
The five of us
decided to open a
shop on the side,
next to our live
gigs~

entries.jp: その名も\n『場亜　オカマちゃん』\n可愛いでしょ　うふっ
entries.en:
It's called 'Bar
Okama-chan'!
Cute, right?
Ufufu~

entries.jp: ば　ばあ……\nおかまちゃん……？
entries.en: B-Bar...\nOkama-chan...?

entries.jp: うん　そうだよぉ
entries.en: Uh-huh, that's\nriiight~

entries.jp:
お登勢やんに
いつまでも
おんぶにだっこじゃ
いけないと思って
entries.en:
I figured we can't
keep leaning on
you forever,
Otose-yan,

entries.jp: あたい　もっと\n働こうと思ったの
entries.en: so li'l old me\ndecided to work\nharder~

entries.jp: そしたら　みんなが\n協力してくれたのお
entries.en:
And then
everybody
pitched in to
help~

entries.jp: お登勢やんを\n吃驚させようと思って\n開店当日まで黙ってたの
entries.en:
We wanted to
surprise you,
Otose-yan, so we
kept it a secret
till opening day~

entries.jp: お登勢やん\nめんごっ♪　てへへ♪
entries.en: Otose-yan,\nsowwy~! Tee hee~

entries.jp: は　はあ　なるほど
entries.en: W-well, I see.

entries.jp: アンタ達の様子が\nいつもと違う理由は\nわかったわ
entries.en:
Now I know why
you're all acting
so different from
usual.

entries.jp: 店名から察するに\n龍ちゃん達はオカマバーを\n始めるつもりなのね
entries.en:
Judging by the
name, Ryo-chan
and the boys are
starting a drag
bar.

entries.jp: 色々と疑問はあるけど\nめでたい開店日にあれこれ\n問い詰めるのは野暮だわ
entries.en:
I've got plenty of
questions, but
grilling them on
their happy
opening day
would be tactless.

entries.jp: ここは割り切って\nこの子達の新たな第一歩を\n祝福しましょう
entries.en:
I'll just roll with it
and celebrate
these kids'
brand-new first
step.

entries.jp: こほん……\nアナタ達\n開店おめでとう
entries.en:
*Ahem*...
Congratulations
on your grand
opening, all of
you.

entries.jp: お客様に愛される\nオカマちゃん目指して\n一生懸命頑張りなさいな
entries.en:
Aim to be drag
darlings the
customers adore,
and give it
everything you've
got.

entries.jp: はいっ　頑張りますわ\n今日からお客様に\n精一杯ご奉仕します
entries.en:
Yes, we'll do our
very best! From
today on, we'll
serve our
customers with all
our hearts.

entries.jp:
フン　言われなくても
やるからには
一位（ナンバーワン）
を目指すわよっ
entries.en:
Hmph, you don't
have to tell me. If
I'm doing this, I'm
going for number
one, honey!

entries.jp: まあ　目指すだけなら\n良いんじゃないのかな\n目指すだけならね
entries.en:
Well, aiming for
it is fine, I guess.
Just aiming, that
is.

entries.jp: 何よ　その言い方\n私に喧嘩売ってるの？\nいつでも受けて立つわよ
entries.en:
What's that
supposed to
mean? You
picking a fight
with me? I'll take
you on anytime!

entries.jp: こらこら二人とも\n喧嘩しないの
entries.en: Now, now, you\ntwo. No fighting.

entries.jp: 開店したばかりのお店\nなんだし　皆で力を合わせ\n盛り立てていかないと
entries.en:
Our shop has only
just opened. We
all have to pull
together and help
it thrive.

entries.jp: ねえ\n歳子（としこ）ちゃん？
entries.en: Isn't that right,\nToshiko-chan?

entries.jp: う　うん……\n桂子（けいこ）ちゃんの\n言う通り　だと思う……わ
entries.en:
Y-yes... I think
Keiko-chan is
right... really, I
do.

entries.jp: それに　\nお客さんの見ている前で\n喧嘩は良くないと思うの
entries.en:
Besides... I don't
think fighting in
front of the
customers is very
nice.

entries.jp: 総美（そうみ）\n晋子（しんこ）　\n出来るだけ仲良くね
entries.en:
Somi, Shinko...
please try to get
along, as best you
can.

entries.jp: へぇ　アナタ達　\n源氏名で呼び合ってるのね\nきっちりしてるじゃない
entries.en:
Well now, you call
each other by
stage names?
How very
professional.

entries.jp: えへへ　そうでしょう
entries.en: Ehehe, right?

entries.jp:
ちなみに　あたいは
このお店では
龍子（りょうこ）って
呼ばれてるんだ～
entries.en:
And by the way,
here at the shop,
everybody calls
me Ryoko~

entries.jp: ふぅん　龍子ちゃんか\n可愛い名前じゃない
entries.en:
Hmm,
Ryoko-chan, is it?
What a cute
name.

entries.jp: でしょでしょ\nみんなに考えてもらったの
entries.en:
Right, right?
Everybody
thought it up for
me!

entries.jp: うふふ　みんなありがとう\nあたい　みんなのこと\nだぁぃっすき
entries.en: Ufufu, thank you,\neveryone! I just\nloooove you all!

entries.jp: あたい　みんなを\n愛してる　ちゅっちゅっ\nぎゅ～～っ♪
entries.en: I love you all!\nSmooch, smooch!\nSqueeeeze~!

entries.jp: 龍子ちゃんったら\nはしゃぎ過ぎよ？\nくすくす　うふふっ
entries.en:
My, Ryoko-chan,
you're getting
carried away,
dear. *Giggle*
Ufufu~

entries.jp: もう　龍子ってば\nあんまり抱きつかないで\n暑苦しいわ
entries.en: Ugh, Ryoko, quit\nhugging me so\nmuch. It's stifling.

entries.jp: 龍子先輩　\nまた髪の毛が跳ねてますよ\n身嗜みを整えて下さいね
entries.en:
Ryoko-senpai,
your hair's
sticking up again.
Do tidy yourself
up, okay?

entries.jp: んっ　龍子の手が\n私の腰に当たって\nくすぐったい……ふっ
entries.en:
Mm... Ryoko's
hand is on my
waist... it tickles...
hff.

entries.jp: わあ　歳子ちゃんの笑顔\nすっごく可愛いっ\nもっとあたいに見せて？
entries.en:
Wow,
Toshiko-chan's
smile is sooo cute!
Show me more of
it?

entries.jp: こちょこちょこちょ
entries.en: Tickle tickle\ntickle~

entries.jp: あぁん　もうっ\n龍子　だめだってば\nもう少し優しくしてぇ
entries.en: Ahh, stop it~\nRyoko, no~ Be a\nlittle gentler~

entries.jp: キャッキャウフフ
entries.en: *Giggle giggle,\nsqueal~*

entries.jp: テラーダに瓜二つの店内に\n龍子達の明るい笑い声が響く
entries.en:
The bright
laughter of Ryoko
and the others
rang through the
shop, a perfect
copy of Terada.

entries.jp:
体をくねらせながら
はしゃぐ龍子達を見て
お登勢は　いつしか
ときめきを感じていた
entries.en:
Watching Ryoko
and the others
frolic, hips
wiggling, Otose
felt her heart
flutter before she
knew it.

entries.jp: ……いい\n……いいわっ
entries.en: ...Nice. ...So nice!

entries.jp: この店に来た時は\nわけがわからなくて\n驚いてばかりだったけど
entries.en:
When I first got
here, I couldn't
make heads or
tails of it, and I
just kept getting
surprised,

entries.jp: この子達　可愛いじゃない\n意外とそっち方面の\n素質があったのね
entries.en:
but these kids are
adorable! Who
knew they had
such a knack for
this sort of thing?

entries.jp: アンタ達　この際だから\nオカマちゃん愛獲として\n店で雷舞をやってみたら？
entries.en:
You know what?
While you're at it,
why not do a live
here at the shop
as drag idols?

entries.jp: ふぇ？
entries.en: Hweh?

entries.jp: だから　アンタ達の曲を\nオカマちゃんバージョンで\nお客に披露するのよ！
entries.en:
I mean, perform
your songs for
the customers --
drag versions!

entries.jp: あっ　それ良い\nすごく面白そう
entries.en: Ooh, I like that.\nSounds super fun.

entries.jp: そうねっ\n私もそう思う\nみんなの前で歌いたいわ
entries.en:
Yes! I think so
too. I want to sing
in front of
everyone.

entries.jp: オカマバーと\nロックの融合……
entries.en: A fusion of drag\nbar and rock...

entries.jp: きゃっ　\n考えただけで素敵っ\n良いと思いますわ！
entries.en:
Kyaa! Just
imagining it is
divine! I think it's
a marvelous idea!

entries.jp: その話　乗ったわ\nこの店の客も私の歌の\n虜にしてあげる！
entries.en:
Count me in! I'll
make this bar's
customers slaves
to my singing too!

entries.jp: あたいも　あたいも\n歌いたーい
entries.en: Me too, me too! I\nwanna siiing!

entries.jp: ふふふ　決まったわね！\nそれじゃあ　今夜この店で\n雷舞をやりましょう
entries.en:
Hehehe, it's
settled! Then
tonight, we'll put
on a live right
here!

entries.jp: 雷舞の衣装は　\nアタシに任せなさい
entries.en: And leave the live\ncostumes to me.

entries.jp: ヒラッヒラのフリッフリで\n超可愛いものを\n用意してあげるからッッ
entries.en:
I'll get you
something frilly
and flouncy and
super cute!!

entries.jp: わあっ\nお登勢やん頼もしい\nありがとう　大好きっ
entries.en:
Wow! Otose-yan,
you're amazing!
Thank you, I love
you!

entries.jp: 期待してるわよ\n私のために最高の衣装を\n用意して頂戴ね
entries.en:
I'm counting on
you. Get me the
best costume
ever, honey.

entries.jp: どんな衣装でも\nボクは完璧に着こなせるよ\nなんたって愛獲だからね♪
entries.en:
I can pull off any
costume
perfectly. I'm an
idol, after all~

entries.jp: ヒラッヒラでフリッフリの\n衣装……楽しみだな\n一度着てみたかったの
entries.en:
A frilly, flouncy
costume... I can't
wait. I've always
wanted to wear
one.

entries.jp: えっ　\n歳子さん　それ本当？\n実は私もなんですの
entries.en:
Oh! Toshiko-san,
is that true?
Actually, so have
I!

entries.jp: お登勢の言葉を聞き\n龍子達五人は\n衣装の話に花を咲かせる
entries.en:
At Otose's words,
Ryoko and the
other four began
chatting excitedly
about costumes.

entries.jp: そんな彼女達を見て\nお登勢は満面の笑みを\n浮かべていた……
entries.en: Watching them,\nOtose wore a\nbeaming smile...

entries.jp: おぉぉーい\nお登勢やーん\n起きるぜよー
entries.en: Heeey! Otose-yan!\nRise and shine, I\ntell ya!

entries.jp: ……うーん
entries.en: ...Mmmh.

entries.jp: 居眠りしてたら\n風邪を引くぜよー
entries.en: Doze off like that\nand you'll catch a\ncold, y'know!

entries.jp: ……はっ
大きな手に肩を揺すられ\nお登勢は顔を上げた
entries.en:
A big hand shook
her by the
shoulder, and
Otose lifted her
head.

entries.jp:
慌てて辺りを見渡すと
お登勢の隣には
見慣れた人物が
立っていた
entries.en:
Looking around
in a fluster, Otose
found a familiar
figure standing
beside her.

entries.jp: あ……龍子ちゃん\nごめんなさい\nぼーっとしてたわ
entries.en: Oh... Ryoko-chan.\nSorry, I was\nspacing out.

entries.jp: 龍子ちゃん？\n誰じゃ　それは
entries.en: Ryoko-chan? Who\nin the world's\nthat?

entries.jp: 誰って　\n龍ちゃんの源氏名でしょ\nで　ここはオカマバー
entries.en:
Who? It's your
stage name,
Ryo-chan. And
this is the drag
bar.

entries.jp: むむむ？　\nさっぱり意味が\nわからんなあ
entries.en: Hmmm? I ain't\nfollowin' you at\nall.

entries.jp: お登勢やん\n寝ぼけてるのか？
entries.en: Otose-yan, you\nstill half asleep?

entries.jp: お登勢やんは\n今の今まで　テラーダで\n居眠りをしてたんじゃけど
entries.en:
Otose-yan, you've
been dozin' right
here at Terada
this whole time.
Huh...

entries.jp: 龍馬の話を聞き\nお登勢は目を丸くした
entries.en: Hearing Ryoma,\nOtose's eyes went\nwide.

entries.jp: も……もしかして\nさっきのアレは\n夢……だったの？
entries.en: D-don't tell me...\nall that just now...\nwas a dream?

entries.jp: お登勢やん寝ぼけてたのか\nどんな夢見てたぜよ
entries.en:
So you were half
asleep, Otose-yan!
What were you
dreamin' about?

entries.jp: そ　そんなぁぁぁ
entries.en: N-nooooo...

entries.jp: あともう少しで\n最高の舞台が観れたのに\nああもう　最悪だわっ
entries.en:
I was this close to
seeing the best
show ever! Ugh,
this is the worst!

entries.jp: えーと　お登勢やん　\n元気出すぜよ
entries.en: Uh... Otose-yan,\ncheer up, I tell ya.

entries.jp: 無理よぉぉっ\nあの続きを見ないと\n元気なんかでないわ
entries.en:
I caaan't! I won't
cheer up until I
see how that
dream ends!

entries.jp: 決めた\nアタシ　二度寝するッッ
entries.en: That's it. I'm\ngoing back to\nsleep!!

entries.jp: ちょ　お登勢やん
entries.en: H-hey, Otose-yan!

entries.jp: 龍馬の呼び掛けに応えず\nお登勢はぎゅっと目を閉じる
entries.en:
Ignoring Ryoma's
call, Otose
squeezed her
eyes shut.

entries.jp: しかし　どんなに願っても\n場亜オカマちゃんの扉は\n二度と開く事はなかった――
entries.en:
But no matter
how hard she
wished, the doors
of Bar
Okama-chan
never opened
again--
